description: This file implements API route handlers for managing 'posts' within a Next.js application. It includes functions for retrieving a paginated list of posts with filtering, sorting, and search capabilities (GET), as well as creating new posts (POST). The code interacts with a MongoDB database via Mongoose models and employs Zod schemas for validation.
